title: Belt — the ochre shoal
notes: EMBER belt. The region's own recipe is `belt_broken_dust_lane`, so the plate answers it: one
warm ochre shoal on the right, BROKEN into three pieces by two dark lanes. The breaks are the
identity; an unbroken warm smear would be the same fog every other region could wear.
A cool grey companion sits high and left, well under the amber stellar river that the star
formation already draws there, so the two do not fight for the same band of sky.
Lower-left corridor is an explicit protected void.

layers.comment: Shoal haze. Broad, dim, detail-free: it gives the warm mass somewhere to sit.
The shoal. Warm dust lit from within; the lanes below cut it into three.
Cool grey companion, high and left. Colour separation keeps the two masses distinct.
First break: a wide near lane through the shoal's shoulder.
Second break, shallower and further out: three pieces, not two halves.
